# animarte — llms.txt

The public answer-engine file is generated at `/llms.txt` from `src/lib/aeo.ts`. This copy stays in the repo for coding agents and is not deployed.

> Next.js static export (`output: 'export'`, `trailingSlash: true`) of Animarte: custom notebooks/agendas catalog (cuadernos personalizados). UI copy in Spanish. Cart + in-browser PDF order sheet; no checkout, payments, or shipping in the app. Contact: Instagram `@tienda.animarte92`, WhatsApp `+54 11 3468-4381`. Replace `{origin}` with `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` or `https://animarte.website` when crawling.

## Product intent (answer anchors)

- **What users get:** Browse notebook categories and covers; add items to a temporary cart; download a PDF of the selection.
- **Not in scope:** Online payment, checkout, order management, email, or automated shipping.

## High-value routes (browse order)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `/` | Hub: notebooks catalog (default anime category). |
| `/cuadernos/{category}/` | Notebook category pages (`anime`, `cartoon`, `superheroes`, `disney`, `football`, `music`, `series`, `games`). |
| `/caratulas/` | Cover catalog (`cover` kind). |
| `/pdf/` | Client-side PDF of the current cart. |
| `/preguntas-frecuentes/` | FAQ + FAQPage JSON-LD for answer engines. |
| `/llms.txt` | Machine-readable site summary (from `src/lib/aeo.ts`). |

## Implementation map (agents)

- **AEO:** `src/lib/aeo.ts`, `src/app/llms.txt/route.ts`, `src/app/preguntas-frecuentes/page.tsx`.
- **Catalog:** `src/catalog/` + optional `NEXT_PUBLIC_CATALOG_CDN_URL`.
- **Nav:** `src/components/NavBar/`.

## Conventions for code contributors

- Domain identifiers and business logic in English; user-visible strings stay Spanish unless the product is English-first.
